title: Direct Cirsium capitulum-orientation mechanism and reproductive-fitness test

source_handoff.interpretation: public comparative evidence nominates pathways but supplies no direct focal Cirsium angle causation

selection_rule: P03 own-data history must leave an ancestry-interpretable focal orientation contrast or repeated neighbourhood
target cannot be selected using expected treatment effect or local fitness outcome
current occupancy and flowering window must be verified
conservation, land-manager, manipulation, collection and seed-removal authorizations must all pass
exact locality remains outside the public repository

primary_question: Does assigned capitulum angle causally change mature viable achene output in Cirsium under the tested field context?
mechanism_question: Is any angle effect consistent with altered reproductive wetting/exposure while thermal, pollination and antagonist pathways are measured as competing explanations?

experimental_unit.admission_rule: primary confirmatory block requires at least two comparable heads on one plant at matched floral stage; otherwise that plant does not enter the paired core design

core_treatments.device: structure-matched support with matched contact/material burden but no intentional angle change

core_treatments.assignment: reversibly move the head toward the opposite biologically relevant orientation domain defined before allocation for the frozen focal taxon
core_treatments.device: same qualified support geometry as sham

randomization.allocation: computer-generated paired allocation frozen before device placement
randomization.analysis: intention-to-treat primary; achieved angle is secondary dose-response
randomization.blinding: achene fill/viability scorer should be treatment-blinded where sample labeling permits

manipulation_checks.device_qualification_gate: numeric tolerances for angle separation and unintended geometry change must be frozen from a treatment-blind technical pilot before field authorization
manipulation_checks.failure_rule: failed manipulation remains in ITT when safe, is flagged; systematic device failure or injury stops the confirmatory run

required_endpoints: viability or germination assessment under authorized seed collection

mechanism_cohort.purpose: allow destructive pollen/reproductive-organ assays without mechanically reducing the primary fitness endpoint
required_endpoints: standardized or naturally observed wetting exposure
stigma pollen deposition where technically valid

wetting.requirement: measure water entry/wetting duration directly on or inside the capitulum; annual BIOCLIM is prohibited as a substitute
wetting.standardized_challenge: allowed on the separate mechanism cohort after device qualification; protocol must freeze water dose/timing before biological outcomes

thermal.requirement: record internal/head temperature with the same temporal window as wetting and visitor observations

uvb.requirement: do not combine with the core confirmatory design unless an independently qualified UV manipulation changes UV-B without altering rain, temperature, display or visitor access
uvb.claim_rule: no UV-B mediation claim from ambient UV correlation alone

pollination.requirement: effective floral contact or pollen transfer, not visit count alone; time of day retained

antagonists.requirement: record discovery/contact/damage where present; absence of damage is not evidence for orientation mechanism

primary_endpoint.name: mature_viable_achene_output
primary_endpoint.operationalization: number of mature filled achenes that pass the predeclared viability/germination criterion per assigned capitulum
primary_endpoint.primary_estimand: intention-to-treat mean contrast REORIENTED minus NATURAL_SHAM within the randomized plant-block design

analysis_plan.primary_model: paired/block-aware generalized model of viable-achene output with treatment assignment as the only focal causal coefficient; plant is the blocking unit and population/site is retained if replicated
analysis_plan.achieved_angle: secondary continuous dose-response; cannot replace ITT
analysis_plan.wetting_model: treatment effect on directly measured wetting duration/water entry
mechanism_models: treatment -> pollen viability/germination in mechanism cohort
analysis_plan.mediation_rule: causal mediation language is prohibited unless wetting or another mediator is independently manipulated under a qualified design; otherwise intermediates are mechanism-consistency evidence only
analysis_plan.multiplicity: one primary fitness estimand; mechanism endpoints are a prespecified secondary family and must be reported jointly, not promoted one-by-one after outcome inspection
analysis_plan.missingness: treatment/device failures and lost heads must be reported by arm; no outcome-dependent replacement

sample_size_gate.rule: freeze minimum biologically meaningful effect, eligible-head census, anticipated block correlation/variance source and final N before treatment allocation; do not estimate N from unblinded treatment effects in the confirmatory cohort
sample_size_gate.failure: if authorized plants/paired heads cannot meet the frozen precision/power target, run only a labelled pilot and do not promote it to the confirmatory causal test

stop_rules: any missing manipulation or collection authorization stops field execution
device causes reproducible tissue injury or alters reproductive structures beyond frozen tolerance
sham and treatment cannot be separated in achieved angle without unequal device burden
authorized paired-head sample cannot meet the frozen sample-size gate
no final viable-achene endpoint means no causal fitness claim
falsifiers: technically successful angle assignment does not change direct wetting/exposure under informative events
technically successful angle assignment produces no repeatable difference in viable-achene output at adequate precision
an alternative pathway explains the treatment effect while the preregistered wetting route is unsupported
effect disappears under matched sham/device controls

claim_ceiling.positive: focal Cirsium assigned-angle -> measured mechanism/competing pathways -> reproductive-fitness effect under the tested context
prohibited: historical selective cause of every orientation transition
causal mediation without independent mediator intervention
